constitutive_scope.control: c2 = 0 is used as a neo-Hookean control

claims.statement: The formal leading constrained/null-family map is y2 = P r^(1/2) sin(theta/2) and y1-c0 = C_s s + P^(-1/2) r^(5/4) g(theta) + ..., with s=r sin(theta/2)^2. The leading constraint does not determine C_s; a full retained-C_s finite-compliance equilibrium branch and its matching remain open
The constraint is invariant under y1 -> y1+F(y2); C_s s is the first analytic Mode-I member and changes the physical horizontal coordinate
Regular-axis outer-branch selection gives g(0)=4 sqrt(2)/5 and g(pi)=2.033311...; full finite-compliance axis/matching selection remains open

For the tested c1=c2=1, lambda=1.6 pure-shear strip, a matching-radius, core, and angular sequence supports the exact-axis r^(5/4) residual class and its parameter-free amplitude. The full-angle residual is consistent with the analytical ODE family when its homogeneous C_h member is admitted. The campaign does not select C_s or C_h and is not a two-way coupled global-local calculation
J r^(1/4) = sqrt(P/2), independent of theta at leading order

On the superposed truncated map, the leading contour flux is exactly independent of arbitrary C_s and gives G = (pi/2) c1 P^2; this calculation is not a completed retained-C_s finite-compliance equilibrium branch
At lambda=1.6, c2/c1 = 1/3, 1, and 3 retain the energy balance, amplitude relation, angular flatness of J r^(1/4), and finite-window opening power
sigma22 r = G/pi at leading order; this relation is class-universal and is shared by the c2=0 control
On the chosen F=0 representative, the first finite material correction is the Lambda=7/4 rung. Its total face traction closes and no new local amplitude is introduced at that rung

On the chosen F=0 (C_s=0) analytic-axis representative, the audited restricted interaction reaches the Lambda=13/4 opening kernel, corresponding to an r^(5/2) opening coefficient. Its nonzero restricted Fredholm projection forces a logarithmic companion in that formal coefficient. The complete same-grade source, coupled response, and specimen-selected net logarithmic amplitude remain open

open_work: global matching of C_s and C_h in the r^(5/4) field
two-way coupling of an independently refined local mesh to the outer strip
a completed coupled finite-compliance spectrum and normalized higher-order extraction integrals
